description: Airport lounges on Lounge Frog with their terminal, hours, editorial rating, who gets in, and page link. Narrow by airport ("which lounges are at JFK?"), by a card, lounge network or airline status program the traveler holds (a card stands for every lounge network it unlocks: "which lounges can I use at LHR with Amex Platinum?"), or by words in the name, airport, city or terminal.

airport.description: IATA code or airport slug, e.g. JFK

include_closed.description: Also list lounges that have closed for good (default false)

program.description: Card, lounge network or airline status program slug (search_programs finds it), e.g. amex-platinum

query.description: Words to look for in the lounge, airport, city or terminal name

name: search_lounges
title: Find lounges
